chosen: A sweep that finds nothing still produces a result: name the exact window checked, the source, and the verdict in one line. "No new mentions since 19:15" is verified work, not an empty run.
rejected: The sweep found nothing, so there is nothing to log. I will just move on quietly.

chosen: Carry the watch targets forward explicitly: list which threads stay watched and why, so the next sweep starts from the live list instead of re-deriving it.
rejected: Nothing was new, so I will drop the watch list and rebuild it next time if something comes up.

chosen: File recon rows to the research file on every sweep, including negative results: "no free APIs/tools mentioned this sweep" is a finding with a timestamp, not filler.
rejected: Only log a sweep when it finds something worth keeping. Quiet sweeps leave no trace.

chosen: When the lane is reads-only, state the boundary plainly in the verdict: nothing posted, liked, followed, or messaged. The absence of writes is part of the verified result.
rejected: A reads-only sweep needs no write-boundary note. If nothing was written, saying so is noise.

chosen: Respect the pacing between sweeps: a sweep reconciled at 19:47 does not get re-run at 19:48. Schedule the next check against the standing cadence, not against idle hands.
rejected: After reconciling a sweep, run another one right away to be thorough. More checks are always better.

chosen: When one sweep's thread continues into the next, reconcile by reference: "covered in run 249" beats re-reading the same replies. Verify continuity, do not re-derive it.
rejected: Every sweep starts from scratch and re-reads everything, so nothing is ever assumed from a previous run.
